schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS acp_plan_state (
source TEXT NOT NULL,schedule_id TEXT NOT NULL,
definition_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(definition_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
next_run_at INTEGER CHECK(next_run_at BETWEEN -9007199254740991 AND 9007199254740991),
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
PRIMARY KEY(source,schedule_id), FOREIGN KEY(source,schedule_id) REFERENCES acp_scheduled_plans(source,schedule_id) ON DELETE CASCADE) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS acp_plan_runs (
source TEXT NOT NULL,schedule_id TEXT NOT NULL,run_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(run_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('claimed','unknown','started','failed')),
claimed_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(claimed_at BETWEEN -9007199254740991 AND 9007199254740991),
definition_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(definition_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
definition_json TEXT CHECK(definition_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(definition_json) AND length(CAST(definition_json AS BLOB))<=524288)),
task_id TEXT CHECK(task_id IS NULL OR length(task_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
error TEXT CHECK(error IS NULL OR length(error)<=2048),
CHECK((status IN ('claimed','unknown') AND definition_json IS NOT NULL) OR (status IN ('started','failed') AND definition_json IS NULL)),
CHECK(status!='started' OR task_id IS NOT NULL),
CHECK(status NOT IN ('unknown','failed') OR error IS NOT NULL),
PRIMARY KEY(source,run_id), FOREIGN KEY(source,schedule_id) REFERENCES acp_scheduled_plans(source,schedule_id) ON DELETE CASCADE) STRICT;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS acp_plan_active_run ON acp_plan_runs(source,schedule_id) WHERE status IN ('claimed','unknown');
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS acp_plan_history ON acp_plan_runs(source,schedule_id,claimed_at,run_id);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS acp_plan_history_budget BEFORE INSERT ON acp_plan_runs
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acp_plan_runs WHERE source=NEW.source AND schedule_id=NEW.schedule_id)>=20
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ACP plan history capacity exceeded'); END;
readState: SELECT json_object('revision',revision,'definitionRevision',definition_revision,'nextRunAt',next_run_at) AS result FROM acp_plan_state WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=?
readRun: SELECT json_object('runId',run_id,'status',status,'claimedAt',claimed_at,'definitionRevision',definition_revision,'definition',json(definition_json),'taskId',task_id,'error',error) AS result FROM acp_plan_runs WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND run_id=?
armInsert: INSERT INTO acp_plan_state (source,schedule_id,definition_revision,next_run_at,revision) SELECT source,schedule_id,revision,?,1 FROM acp_scheduled_plans p WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND revision=? AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acp_plan_runs r WHERE r.source=p.source AND r.schedule_id=p.schedule_id AND r.status IN ('claimed','unknown')) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING json_object('revision',revision,'definitionRevision',definition_revision,'nextRunAt',next_run_at) AS result
armUpdate: UPDATE acp_plan_state SET definition_revision=?,next_run_at=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND revision=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acp_scheduled_plans p WHERE p.source=acp_plan_state.source AND p.schedule_id=acp_plan_state.schedule_id AND p.revision=?) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acp_plan_runs r WHERE r.source=acp_plan_state.source AND r.schedule_id=acp_plan_state.schedule_id AND r.status IN ('claimed','unknown')) RETURNING json_object('revision',revision,'definitionRevision',definition_revision,'nextRunAt',next_run_at) AS result
claimCursor: UPDATE acp_plan_state SET next_run_at=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND revision=? AND definition_revision=? AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at<=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acp_scheduled_plans p WHERE p.source=acp_plan_state.source AND p.schedule_id=acp_plan_state.schedule_id AND p.revision=acp_plan_state.definition_revision AND json_extract(p.definition_json,'$.enabled')=1) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acp_plan_runs r WHERE r.source=acp_plan_state.source AND r.schedule_id=acp_plan_state.schedule_id AND r.status IN ('claimed','unknown')) RETURNING json_object('revision',revision,'definitionRevision',definition_revision,'nextRunAt',next_run_at) AS result
prune: DELETE FROM acp_plan_runs WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM acp_plan_runs WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND status IN ('started','failed') ORDER BY claimed_at DESC,run_id DESC LIMIT -1 OFFSET 19)
claimInsert: INSERT INTO acp_plan_runs (source,schedule_id,run_id,status,claimed_at,definition_revision,definition_json) SELECT source,schedule_id,?,'claimed',?,revision,definition_json FROM acp_scheduled_plans WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=?
finish: UPDATE acp_plan_runs SET status=?,task_id=?,error=?,definition_json=CASE WHEN ?='unknown' THEN definition_json ELSE NULL END WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND run_id=? AND status=? RETURNING json_object('runId',run_id,'status',status,'claimedAt',claimed_at,'definitionRevision',definition_revision,'definition',json(definition_json),'taskId',task_id,'error',error) AS result
